# Listings Project

> > A community-driven platform connecting creative professionals with housing, sublets, and workspace opportunities primarily in New York City neighborhoods and beyond.

Listings Project serves artists, writers, and creative individuals seeking short-term rentals, furnished apartments, studio spaces, and roommate arrangements. The platform emphasizes community connections across Brooklyn, Manhattan, and other creative hubs, with a focus on flexible, artist-friendly living and working spaces.

## Key Topics

- Short-term rentals and sublets
- Brooklyn neighborhoods (Bushwick, Clinton Hill, Greenpoint, Williamsburg, Fort Greene, Crown Heights)
- Manhattan housing (Chelsea, Upper West Side, East Village)
- Furnished apartments and rooms
- Pet-friendly housing
- Artist studios and creative workspaces
- Summer sublets
- Roommate matching
- Studio apartments
- Private bathroom rentals
- Artist community living
- Astoria and Ridgewood Queens
- Carroll Gardens and Boerum Hill
- Workspace sharing
- International listings (London, Mexico City)
